title: Good App, Unreasonable Pricing
text:
The app itself works fine, but the subscription pricing is hard to justify. Scanning QR codes is a very basic function, yet many of the app’s features are locked behind an expensive recurring subscription. There are plenty of other apps that provide the same functionality for free or with a much more reasonable one-time purchase.

If the pricing were more in line with what the app actually offers, I’d be happy to recommend it. As it stands, the value just isn’t there.
